doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: Desktop-first accounting workspace optimized for speed and accuracy. Minimal, information-dense layouts with clear hierarchy. Clean, professional financial UI; neutral palette with accent for primary actions. Use Tailwind CSS with CSS variables for theming; Shadcn UI components for consistency.

doc.title: Decision Architecture
doc.section: Decision Summary, Project Structure, Implementation Patterns
doc.snippet: Frontend uses React + TypeScript, shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS. Project structure: feature-first organization with layouts/ProtectedLayout.tsx, components/app/app-sidebar.tsx, components/app/nav-main.tsx. Theme management: Use Tailwind CSS dark mode with CSS variables, implement theme provider if needed.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Components: shadcn/ui (Radix primitives) with Tailwind CSS utilities. Layout: sidebar-06 pattern via layouts/ProtectedLayout.tsx with SidebarProvider, AppSidebar, SidebarInset, SidebarTrigger. Authentication: features/auth/pages/Login.tsx with LoginForm. Feedback: Toasts via sonner.

doc.title: Epic 1 Technical Specification
doc.snippet: Frontend bootstrapping includes React + TS + Vite, shadcn/ui layout using layouts/ProtectedLayout.tsx (sidebar-06), basic features/dashboard/pages/Dashboard.tsx. Auth endpoints: POST /api/v1/auth/login, refresh, logout.

doc.title: Epic Breakdowns
doc.section: Epic 1: Project Foundation & Secure Authentication - Story 1.7
doc.snippet: Story 1.7: MVP Branding & App Layout. Acceptance criteria include branded login page with logo and color scheme, authenticated layout with persistent sidebar and header, username/company/role visibility, professional design with loading/error states, responsive design for 1920x1080 and 1366x768.

doc.title: Story 1.6: Company Settings
doc.snippet: New Service Created: StorageService and SupabaseStorageService for logo uploads - company logo URL available at company.logoUrl field. API Endpoints: GET /api/v1/admin/company/settings returns company details including logoUrl, name, taxCode, address, contactEmail, contactPhone, fiscalYearStart. PUT /api/v1/admin/company/settings supports multipart upload for logo.
